_comment: AI-Assisted: Claude Code (model: claude-opus-5) - Authored per 004 data-model.md §4 and research D7 (004 task T014), for curation/keyword-classes.json. The curator writes only the EXCEPTIONS to a deterministic default: a non-faction keyword is 'unit'; a faction keyword resolving to a faction with no parent is 'faction'; anything else is unclassified and awaits a record here. Of 1 423 distinct keywords in the measured baseline only 46 are faction keywords, so the authoring surface is at most 46 records and realistically about 20 -- the cheapest of this feature's five content gaps by a wide margin. An unclassified keyword ships EXACTLY as it does today, blocks nothing, and raises the advisory KWD-UNCLASSIFIED (FR-020).
title: curation/keyword-classes.json

parent_faction_id.description: Required when keyword_class is 'chapter'. FR-019 guarantees one parent per chapter keyword, which is what lets chapter-keywords.json key by keyword alone.

chapter_faction_id.description: Present when the points source models this chapter as a faction of its own. That faction's own parent_faction_id MUST equal this record's parent_faction_id, or the blocking KWD-CHAPTER-PARENT-CONFLICT stops the run (FR-019).

note.description: A curator's sentence about MECHANICS OR PROCESS. It must not quote source text.
